summary: Final pre-GO regression of the Patient Portal Rx Refill redesign (PREVIEW only, nothing deployed). Backend B1-B11 + R1/R2: 15/15 pytest passing. Frontend F1-F7 all pass end to end (portal mode chooser, catalog + manual extras, blister preselect, medication-change panel, due nudge skip/add/absent, physician Rx queue banners/cards/Convert to Prescription draft, Medical Record stop→discontinued, Pharmacy intake blister toggle). I found no blocking defects. There are a few UX/copy and code-quality issues, listed below. Note: /app/test_reports/iteration_10.json already existed from an older run, so this report is iteration_88.json and does not overwrite it.

minor.issue: 'continue' sets last_prescribed_at=now even though no Rx is sent. That resets the coverage/due clock (likely_due and refill reminders) and the 'Last sent' label in the Medical Record, so a click without sending looks like a sent Rx. Suggest leaving last_prescribed_at alone (or using a separate continued_at).

encounters/documents query uses the raw patient_id path param. With 'directory:<id>', appointments keyed by the portal id are not returned even though the medications resolve via _scoped_med_refs. Should use p['id'] once resolved. ROMERO has no encounters, so this was found by code review and not shown live.

An unknown request_mode silently falls back to 'selected' instead of returning 400. all_regular/blister_pack do not check that the items match the patient's regular list (acceptable, but worth knowing).

ui_bugs.issue: After Convert to Prescription from a PATIENT portal request, the toast says 'Draft prepared from pharmacy request' and the banner says 'Prepared from pharmacy renewal request … values are pharmacy-supplied'. The copy is wrong for source=patient_refill.
The manual-entry card ('Blue pill') shows up as a normal draft medication with no MANUAL ENTRY / review flag on the Send Rx page.

integration_issues.issue: medications_structured is sent only from Smart-paste parsed meds. Ticked active meds and the manual text box are plain strings, so a blister intake built that way has no individual cards and no Convert button. The intake snapshot also shows 'No synchronized medications yet' for maria, who has 3 active patient_medications, so staff have to re-paste.

issues: The 'Call the clinic · (416) 652-7667' button is truncated to '(416) 6…' in the 2-column grid inside the narrow card. Mobile (390) is fine. Use 1 column or shorter text.
'Previously prescribed through VIen' toggle and selectable cards still render under the change panel. Clicking them toggles a selection that is ignored on submit, which is confusing.
The note textarea state is shared between change mode and refill mode, so text carries over when switching modes.
When checked, the blister toggle has a grey background with light violet text: low contrast.
Banner title text (indigo on dark indigo) is barely legible.

action_items: Fix the SendPrescription convert toast/banner copy for patient-sourced requests (patient_refill) and carry the MANUAL / review flag onto draft cards
Stop overwriting last_prescribed_at on 'continue' (it skews due/reminder logic and the 'Last sent' label)
medical-record: use the resolved portal id for encounters/documents when called with directory:<id>
Medication-change panel: fix phone truncation on desktop and hide the Previously-prescribed selectable list in change mode
Optional: pharmacy intake should build structured cards for ticked active meds and show authoritative patient_medications
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 11k lines; the portal Rx (rx-requests, medications) and medical-record sections should move into modules
continue action resets the coverage clock (see backend minor)
medical-record encounters use the raw path id (see backend minor)
The due nudge only re-evaluates on submit; that is fine, but dueNudge is not cleared when the selection changes

success_rate.frontend: 100% of F1-F7 flows functional; copy/design issues noted
